reason: This plugin is primarily a DSH bridge for external agent-ecosystem interoperability: it discovers and imports plugins/marketplaces from Codex, Claude Code, and Pi, normalizes their package formats, and installs supported components as DSH rows. User-facing `/plugin-bridge` commands then control installation, discovery, review, enabling, disabling, and uninstalling, matching a plugin orchestration role rather than plugin authoring.

summaries.zh: 该插件将 Codex、Claude Code 与 Pi 的插件与市场能力桥接到 DSH，可通过 /plugin-bridge 命令发现、导入并安装支持的技能、MCP 与钩子组件。
summaries.en: This plugin bridges supported plugins, skills, and MCP-style components from Codex, Claude Code, and Pi into DSH, and exposes /plugin-bridge commands to discover, import, and install them.

capabilities: Imports and installs plugin packages from local paths, marketplace identifiers, and GitHub sources
Normalizes and materializes supported components (skills, MCP servers, hooks) into explicit DSH runtime rows
Reads user agent/plugin registries from local config locations for discovery and import
Provides command-driven activation lifecycle with review/approve/enable/disable/uninstall operations

reasons.code: Marketplace and install operations accept remote and local plugin sources before copying into profile-local storage
MCP adapter materializes valid servers as rows and supports stdio/streamable-http transport execution
Discovery layers parse explicit registry files under ~/.codex, ~/.claude, and ~/.pi and act on their contents
